description: Auto-detects test framework (pytest/jest/vitest/mocha), runs tests, returns structured results with failures.

args.description: Additional arguments to pass to the test runner. Each element is validated to prevent flag injection.

bail.description: Fail fast after N failures (maps to --maxfail=N for pytest, --bail=N for jest/vitest, --bail for mocha). Pass true for 1.

config.description: Path to test config file (--config for all frameworks)

coverage.description: Run with coverage (adds --coverage for vitest/jest, --cov for pytest)

exitFirst.description: Stop on first test failure (maps to -x for pytest, --bail=1 for jest/vitest, -b for mocha)

filter.description: Test filter pattern (file path or test name pattern)

framework.description: Force a specific framework instead of auto-detecting

interpreter.description: Python interpreter path to use for pytest (overrides venv/PATH detection)

onlyChanged.description: Run only tests affected by recent changes (maps to --lf for pytest, --onlyChanged for jest, --changed for vitest)

passWithNoTests.description: Exit successfully when no tests are found (maps to --passWithNoTests for jest/vitest)

shard.description: Shard spec for distributed test execution (e.g., "1/3") via --shard (jest/vitest)

testNamePattern.description: Filter tests by name pattern (maps to -k for pytest, --testNamePattern for jest/vitest, --grep for mocha)

timeout.description: Per-test timeout in milliseconds (maps to --timeout for pytest-timeout, --testTimeout for jest/vitest, --timeout for mocha)

workers.description: Number of parallel workers (maps to -n for pytest-xdist, --maxWorkers for jest, --pool.threads.maxThreads for vitest, --jobs for mocha)

name: run
title: Run Tests
